items.title: Wonder CEO Marc Lore on $650M funding round, $9B valuation
items.summary: Wonder CEO Marc Lore joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss the company's $650 million Series D funding round, which values the food delivery startup at a $9 billion pre-money valuation. The round includes new investors such as funds managed by AllianceBernstein and ARK Invest. Lore also discusses what's next for Wonder.
